title: todo-tree@1
description: The Todo manager's store: ONE tree of nodes. A list, a note, a to-do and a task are all nodes; any kind may hold any kind through parentId, to any depth. Siblings are ordered by a fractional order key. Deleted subtrees sit in the trash with an undo token; every change is journalled in ops so it can be undone. Spec: apps/console-web/plugins/todo-manager/SPEC.md.

project.description: projects@1 id the store belongs to (absent = the base project).

trash.description: Deleted subtrees, newest last. Restored by token; the oldest fall off after maxItems.

ops.description: The op log, oldest first. Each op carries what every touched node looked like before and after, so any op can be undone or replayed.

seq.description: Sequence number of the last op (ops may have been pruned below it).

id.description: Node id. Migrated nodes keep their todo-store@1 integer as a string ('4'); new nodes get 'n-<base36 time><random>'. The prefix means nothing afterwards.

kind.description: Built-ins: list, note, todo, task. Any other value is an open slot for a later kind; the engine treats an unknown kind like a note (no tick box). A kind never restricts what it may hold or be held by.

orderKey.description: Fractional order key: a base-62 fraction in (0, 1) with no trailing '0', compared as a plain string. The engine makes a key between any two neighbours without renumbering.

status.description: Detail behind done. done is true exactly when status is 'done'. todo-store@1's in_progress reads as doing.

due.description: A local day 'YYYY-MM-DD', or a local day and time 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm'.

node.description: One node of the tree. Every field is valid on every kind; the kind only decides what the UI shows and whether the node has a tick box (todo, task).

parentId.description: The node that holds this one; null = the root. Any kind may hold any kind. The engine refuses a move that would make a node its own ancestor.

doneAt.description: When done became true; null while open.

collapsed.description: Children folded in the tree (view state shared by every client).

fields.description: Custom fields by key, as todo-store@1 held them. Opaque to the engine.

token.description: Undo token handed back by delete; restore and undo take it.

parentId.description: Where the root sat. Restoring into a parent that is gone puts it at the root.

nodes.description: The root and every descendant exactly as they were.

before.description: null = the node did not exist before the op.

after.description: null = the op removed the node.

nodeId.description: The node the op was aimed at (the root of a subtree op).

args.description: The call as made, for the journal reader. Never needed to undo.

trashToken.description: On delete: the trash entry made; on restore / undo: the one consumed.

undoes.description: On undo: the token of the op that was reverted.

by.description: Who or what made the change (console, voice, mcp, cli, migrate).

backup.description: Path of the todo-store@1 backup the migration wrote.

legacyTypes.description: The todo-store@1 per-kind type schema, kept as it was so nothing Brett configured is lost.
